cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(native_window VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(CTest)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(NW_WAYLAND REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET wayland-client>=1.22 wayland-cursor xkbcommon)
pkg_check_modules(NW_PROTOCOLS REQUIRED wayland-protocols>=1.32)
pkg_get_variable(NW_PROTOCOL_DIR wayland-protocols pkgdatadir)
find_program(WAYLAND_SCANNER wayland-scanner REQUIRED)
set(NW_GENERATED "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/protocols")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${NW_GENERATED}")
set(NW_PROTOCOL_SOURCES)
function(nw_protocol name relative)
  set(xml "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/protocols/${name}.xml")
  if(NOT EXISTS "${xml}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing pinned protocol ${xml}")
  endif()
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${NW_GENERATED}/${name}-client-protocol.h" "${NW_GENERATED}/${name}-protocol.c"
    COMMAND "${WAYLAND_SCANNER}" client-header "${xml}" "${NW_GENERATED}/${name}-client-protocol.h"
    COMMAND "${WAYLAND_SCANNER}" private-code "${xml}" "${NW_GENERATED}/${name}-protocol.c" DEPENDS "${xml}" VERBATIM)
  set(NW_PROTOCOL_SOURCES ${NW_PROTOCOL_SOURCES} "${NW_GENERATED}/${name}-client-protocol.h" "${NW_GENERATED}/${name}-protocol.c" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
nw_protocol(xdg-shell stable/xdg-shell/xdg-shell.xml)
nw_protocol(viewporter stable/viewporter/viewporter.xml)
nw_protocol(fractional-scale-v1 staging/fractional-scale/fractional-scale-v1.xml)
nw_protocol(xdg-decoration-unstable-v1 unstable/xdg-decoration/xdg-decoration-unstable-v1.xml)
nw_protocol(relative-pointer-unstable-v1 unstable/relative-pointer/relative-pointer-unstable-v1.xml)
nw_protocol(pointer-constraints-unstable-v1 unstable/pointer-constraints/pointer-constraints-unstable-v1.xml)
nw_protocol(cursor-shape-v1 staging/cursor-shape/cursor-shape-v1.xml)
nw_protocol(tablet-unstable-v2 unstable/tablet/tablet-unstable-v2.xml)
nw_protocol(text-input-unstable-v3 unstable/text-input/text-input-unstable-v3.xml)
nw_protocol(idle-inhibit-unstable-v1 unstable/idle-inhibit/idle-inhibit-unstable-v1.xml)
add_library(native_window_core STATIC src/window.cpp src/decorations.cpp src/decoration_pixels.cpp ${NW_PROTOCOL_SOURCES})
add_library(native_window::core ALIAS native_window_core)
target_compile_features(native_window_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(native_window_core PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" PRIVATE "${NW_GENERATED}" src)
target_link_libraries(native_window_core PUBLIC PkgConfig::NW_WAYLAND)
target_compile_options(native_window_core PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-Wall;-Wextra;-Wpedantic>)
option(NATIVE_WINDOW_BUILD_EXAMPLE "Build standalone core-only consumer (never launched by tests)" ON)
if(NATIVE_WINDOW_BUILD_EXAMPLE)
  add_executable(native_window_consumer examples/consumer.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(native_window_consumer PRIVATE native_window::core)
endif()
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(native_window_decoration_tests tests/decoration_tests.cpp src/decoration_pixels.cpp)
  target_compile_features(native_window_decoration_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(native_window_decoration_tests PRIVATE src)
  add_test(NAME native_window_decoration_pixels COMMAND native_window_decoration_tests)
  add_executable(native_window_core_tests tests/core_tests.cpp)
  target_compile_features(native_window_core_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_include_directories(native_window_core_tests PRIVATE src)
  add_test(NAME native_window_core_helpers COMMAND native_window_core_tests)
  add_executable(native_window_connection_tests tests/connection_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(native_window_connection_tests PRIVATE native_window::core)
  add_test(NAME native_window_connection_errors COMMAND native_window_connection_tests)
  set_tests_properties(native_window_connection_errors PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 5)
  add_executable(native_window_state_tests tests/state_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(native_window_state_tests PRIVATE native_window::core)
  target_include_directories(native_window_state_tests PRIVATE src "${NW_GENERATED}")
  add_test(NAME native_window_state COMMAND native_window_state_tests)
endif()
